# Zanzibaba Timber — Timber, Marine Board & Plywood Supplier in Zanzibar

## About
Zanzibaba Timber is Zanzibar's leading supplier of treated pine timber, marine board, plywood, construction timber and treated poles. We serve Paje, Nungwi, Stone Town and all Zanzibar with cash on delivery, mobile money & bank transfer accepted. FREE island-wide delivery.

## Products
- Treated Softwood Timber
- Hardwood Timber
- Treated Wood Poles
- Marine Board
- Plywood
- Construction Plywood
- Concrete Formwork Marine Board

## Services
- Timber Supply
- Marine Board Supply
- Plywood Supply
- Treated Poles Supply
- Construction Materials Supply
- Hotel & Villa Supply
- Government Supply
- Wholesale Supply

## Locations
- Headquarters: Kwa Ndevu, Daraja Bovu, Zanzibar
- Service coverage: Zanzibar City, Stone Town, Paje, Nungwi, Kendwa, Kiwengwa, Jambiani, Matemwe, Fumba, Bububu, Chukwani, Ndevu
